name: Company-Scoped Data Boundaries Validation
objectives: Verify company-scoped data boundaries across key API routes and middlewares
Ensure agent keys and JWT tokens cannot access other companies' tasks or data
Verify user session memberships and viewer read-only constraints on mutating methods
Implement regression validation to ensure no features of 1.1 or 1.2 are broken
Output validation scorecard and pass autonomous self-test gate checks
